methodology: Popularity snapshot captured with the authenticated GitHub REST API at 2026-11-03T01:35:43Z using the following searches (search/repositories, sort=stars, order=desc, per_page=100): "topic:sillytavern-extension"; "topic:sillytavern-extensions"; "topic:sillytavern"; "sillytavern extension in:name,description"; "sillytavern-extensions in:name,description"; "sillytavern extension in:description"; "sillytavern extension in:name"; plus "org:SillyTavern", "topic:sillytavern-plugin", "topic:tavern-helper", and the author listings users/LenAnderson/repos, users/bmen25124/repos, users/Lodactio/repos. Additional exclusion-evidence searches were "JS-Slash-Runner" and '"Tavern Helper" in:name,description'. Duplicates are removed by repository full_name case-insensitively, keeping the most-starred row, and forks/mirrors are not counted separately when a canonical or more-starred copy is present. Candidate inclusion: a repository that those queries surfaced as a SillyTavern extension candidate with at least 30 stars at the snapshot, every SillyTavern-org downloadable client extension, every Tavern Helper family repository surfaced by the dedicated searches, and the non-client/other-category repositories those same queries return near the top. Ranking for eligible candidates is stars PRIMARY descending, forks SECONDARY descending, pushedAt TIE BREAKER descending, then official/community-listing membership as the final tie breaker (the official listing is https://docs.sillytavern.app/extensions/ and the SillyTavern org extension repositories; the community listing is the topic/author search surface above). The 20 selected are the top 20 eligible repositories after those filters; testability exclusions are recorded with the failing reason in the candidate table. This is not an official Top 20; it is the top 20 eligible extensions by the documented popularity snapshot/ranking methodology.
